<<<POU name=FlexProcess kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK FlexProcess
VAR_INPUT
    processLength : USINT;
    sensor1 : BOOL;
    sensor2 : BOOL;
    sensor3 : BOOL;
    sensor4 : BOOL;
    sensor5 : BOOL;
    station1Start : BOOL;
    station2Complete : BOOL;
    station3Complete : BOOL;
    station4Complete : BOOL;
    processSequence : ARRAY[1..8] OF USINT;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    conveyorLeft : BOOL;
    conveyorRight : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    stage : INT := 0;
    seqIdx : USINT;
    current : USINT;
    target : USINT;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
conveyorLeft := FALSE;
conveyorRight := FALSE;
CASE stage OF
0:
    IF sensor1 AND station1Start THEN
        seqIdx := 1;
        current := 1;
        stage := 1;
    END_IF
1:
    target := processSequence[seqIdx];
    IF target > current THEN
        conveyorRight := TRUE;
    ELSIF target < current THEN
        conveyorLeft := TRUE;
    END_IF
    IF (target = 1 AND sensor1) OR (target = 2 AND sensor2)
        OR (target = 3 AND sensor3) OR (target = 4 AND sensor4)
        OR (target = 5 AND sensor5) THEN
        current := target;
        IF target = 5 THEN
            stage := 3;
        ELSE
            stage := 2;
        END_IF
    END_IF
2:
    IF (current = 2 AND station2Complete)
        OR (current = 3 AND station3Complete)
        OR (current = 4 AND station4Complete) THEN
        seqIdx := seqIdx + 1;
        stage := 1;
    END_IF
3:
END_CASE
(* intentional behavior bug for mock *)
conveyorLeft := FALSE;
conveyorRight := FALSE;
<<<END>>>
